source_name: Raiffeisen Research – CEE Banking Sector Report (annual, Slovenia included)
why_relevant: Bank-analyst (sell-side) annual benchmark of CEE banking markets that names Slovenia in specifics such as banking-sector taxation and cross-border market share — a forward-looking view distinct from supervisory data.

source_name: SeeNews – Slovenia economy/banking rating-action wire
why_relevant: SEE-focused wire that reliably summarises paywalled Moody's/S&P/Fitch actions on Slovenian banks in English within hours — the practical substitute when agency PDFs are inaccessible.

source_name: RTV SLO gospodarstvo – Slovenian-language reporting on rating agency actions
why_relevant: Public broadcaster with the deepest sl-language archive of 'bonitetna ocena' stories covering both sovereign and multi-bank agency actions; supplies the local terminology and the historical timeline agencies paywall.

source_name: AJPES S.BON – domestic credit-scoring service and methodology
why_relevant: Slovenia's state agency runs a Basel-based domestic rating model (SB1–SB10) over the statutory annual accounts every company files; it is the local analogue of a rating agency and the reference methodology Slovenian counterparties actually cite.

source_name: eBonitete.si (Prva bonitetna agencija) – private Slovenian credit-rating provider
why_relevant: Commercial domestic bonitete provider aggregating Slovenian company financials into PRO ratings; useful as a cross-check on AJPES scores and as an actor in the domestic credit-assessment landscape.

source_name: TheBanks.eu – bank profile and credit-ratings aggregator for Slovenian institutions
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator that consolidates current Moody's/Fitch/S&P grades per Slovenian bank in one comparable page (e.g. OTP banka BBB-/A3), handy as a fast cross-bank snapshot before paying for agency data.

source_name: MojeDelo.com - Slovenian job portal (IT / banking categories)
why_relevant: Largest general Slovenian job board; bank and fintech postings here name concrete platforms, vendors, programmes and team build-outs (core banking migration, instant payments, AML, data platforms) months before any public announcement.

source_name: Optius.com - job portal with per-employer pages
why_relevant: Optius maintains stable per-company URLs (NLB, Deželna banka, UniCredit, OTP, Halcom) plus a 'Bančništvo, Finance' and 'Informatika, Programiranje' category — an ideal structured entry point for tracking which Slovenian banks are hiring what.

source_name: Zaposlitev.net - job portal (aggregates Deloglasnik/Optius feeds)
why_relevant: Third major SI board with location-scoped search (Ljubljana, Maribor, Kranj) and a banking/insurance/finance/accounting category; useful for catching regional bank and savings-bank hiring that never reaches LinkedIn.

source_name: Zavod RS za zaposlovanje (ZRSZ / ESS) - official public vacancy register
why_relevant: The state employment service is where employers post vacancies free of charge; it is the most complete and least self-selected Slovenian vacancy set, and an RSS feed is referenced. Banks post here too, including roles they do not market on LinkedIn.

source_name: LinkedIn Jobs Slovenia - banking/payments filter
why_relevant: Senior and English-language roles (Senior Product Manager Payments, Full-Stack Engineer FinTech) surface here first; LinkedIn also exposes company headcount growth and new-hire announcements, the clearest org-build-out signal.

source_name: BetterCareer.si - Slovenian IT-only job portal with company pages
why_relevant: IT-specialised board; company pages exist for Halcom and Banka Intesa Sanpaolo. Because it is tech-only, ads are unusually explicit about stack (Java, .NET, Kafka, cloud, Temenos-style core systems).

source_name: Careerjet.si - job aggregator with per-company pages
why_relevant: Aggregates across SI boards and employer sites, so it catches ads that only ever lived on a bank's own careers page; per-company and per-sector URLs (NLB Group, OTP Banka, bančništvo Ljubljana) make it a good discovery layer for new actors.

source_name: Borza dela (borzadela.si) - job search aggregator
why_relevant: Another SI aggregator surfacing employer-keyword pages (e.g. 'banka slovenije'); useful redundancy for ads pulled quickly from primary boards.

source_name: Zaposlitev.info - banking/finance category
why_relevant: Small SI board with a dedicated banking/finance category; low volume but occasionally carries ads from smaller savings banks and payment intermediaries.

source_name: NLB Group careers - open positions
why_relevant: Largest SEE-headquartered banking group; its own vacancy list is the primary record of where NLB is investing (digital banking unit, data, cyber, payments) and is published in both SL and EN.

source_name: OTP banka d.d. (Slovenia) - Kariera
why_relevant: Post-merger entity (ex-SKB + ex-Nova KBM integration work); hiring for integration, core-banking migration and IT roles is a direct read on where the merger programme actually stands.

source_name: Intesa Sanpaolo Bank Slovenija - Zaposlujemo
why_relevant: Slovenian arm of an international group; local ads reveal which group platforms are being localised and which functions are kept in-country versus hubbed abroad.

source_name: Deželna banka Slovenije - Zaposlitve
why_relevant: Smaller domestic bank; explicitly advertises specialists in payment operations ('plačilni promet'), so its ads mark where a mid-tier bank is modernising versus outsourcing to Bankart.

source_name: Bankart d.o.o. - Zaposlitev / Join our Team
why_relevant: The shared card/ATM/POS processor and SIMP SEPA infrastructure operator for Slovenian banks. Its job ads (e.g. business analyst for IT services in modern payment-instrument processing) are the single sharpest signal of what payment capability the whole Slovenian banking sector is about to gain.

source_name: Bankart d.o.o. LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Bankart posts its vacancies and team news on LinkedIn; company page also exposes headcount trend and function mix, which is the org-build-out signal for the national card processor.

source_name: Halcom d.d. / Halcom plačila d.o.o. - Zaposlitev
why_relevant: Leading CEE/SEE e-banking and payment-systems vendor with a separate licensed payments entity (Halcom plačila d.o.o.). Its hiring by location (Ljubljana, Maribor, Nova Gorica, Ajdovščina) and by product line signals which bank projects and which markets it is scaling into.

source_name: UniCredit Banka Slovenije - vacancies via Optius employer page
why_relevant: International group subsidiary; local postings show which functions remain in Slovenia versus group hubs, and which digital/payment programmes are being staffed locally.

source_name: EURES Slovenia - living and working conditions / EU vacancy network
why_relevant: EU-level vacancy network fed by ZRSZ; useful as a machine-readable cross-border mirror of Slovenian vacancies and for spotting SI banks/fintechs recruiting abroad (a scale-up signal).

source_name: NLB press releases (corporate media centre) as hiring/programme corroboration
why_relevant: Not a job source itself, but the confirmation layer: a product launch announcement (e.g. the NLB Private mobile app) can be back-matched to the job ads that preceded it, letting you calibrate the hiring-to-launch lead time for the whole cell.

source_name: mjob.si - Slovenian job portal
why_relevant: Additional SI board identified via competitor analysis of optius.com/ess.gov.si; worth a coverage check so that bank ads posted only on secondary boards are not missed.

source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) – Strokovna izobraževanja (conferences, posveti, seminars)
why_relevant: Master page of the Slovenian Banking Association's event portfolio: the spring banking conference plus recurring sector 'posveti' that map exactly to payments intelligence — Posvet o kartičnem poslovanju (card business), Posvet o plačilnih storitvah (payment services), IT posvet, Posvet zakladnikov, Posvet o skladnosti poslovanja. Agendas name the bank/processor executives who speak and the themes they are prioritising.

source_name: ZBS – Terminski plan (event calendar / schedule of events)
why_relevant: Forward-looking calendar of all ZBS events. The single best early-warning pointer for when card, payment-services and IT posveti will occur, letting collection be timed to when agendas and speaker lists appear.
